fine_tuning_state.description: State of the voice's fine tuning to filter by. Applicable only to professional voices clones. One of 'draft', 'not_verified', 'not_started', 'queued', 'fine_tuning', 'fine_tuned', 'failed', 'delayed'

include_total_count.description: Whether to include the total count of voices found in the response. NOTE: The total_count value is a live snapshot and may change between requests as users create, modify, or delete voices. For pagination, rely on the has_more flag instead.
